verdict.line: You lose if you let Mundo free-hit you with Q cleavers before level 3 or drag the fight past his R; you win if you grab-stun the second your E is up at level 3, before his cleaver damage or Maximum Dosage sustain snowballs.

brief.thesis: The numbers say this is essentially a coinflip — 49% over 288 games — but the shape is lopsided by phase: Sett has the lane and solo-kill edge because Mundo has zero hard CC to stop the E-into-Q all-in once it's online, while Mundo has zero answer to that all-in besides raw HP. The whole matchup is decided by whether you force the fight in the level 3-5 window before his passive HP steroid and eventual R make him unkillable.

theirWindow.what: You have no gap-closer or stun yet, so every Q he lands is a free trade for him. Stand behind minions so the cleaver hits a wave unit first instead of you, and don't walk up to contest CS you don't need.

yourWindow.when: Level 3+, E off cooldown, he's under 6
yourWindow.what: Grab with E (Facebreaker) the instant it's up, follow with Q (Knuckle Down) for the double-punch and W (Haymaker) to heal through the trade. His passive only clears slows on ability cast, not stuns, so your E lands clean — commit hard here before his HP scaling comes online.

start.why: Highest-picked start at 79.4% and the sustain from lifesteal plus the potion offsets the free Q cleaver chip you're eating before level 3.

boots.why: Best-performing boots at 54.2%; the flat movement speed lets you close the gap on Mundo before he throws another cleaver and helps you disengage his W (Heart Zapper) zap radius.

core.why: The active gives you the closing speed to stick an E onto Mundo before he kites with a cleaver, and it's the base of the highest-winrate path at 65.2%.
Armor shred and ability haste directly counter his growing HP-percent tankiness and shorten your E cooldown for repeat all-ins.
Scales your own HP to match his stacking, keeping your trades even in extended skirmishes past level 11.

situational.when: he's out-sustaining your burst and you need current-HP damage instead of one-shot burst
he's building damage items and threatening to burst you back during your all-in
the enemy team stacks CC beyond just Mundo's kit
the game is going long and you want to snowball cooldowns on E for repeat picks

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are unavoidable against Mundo's sustain, and Conqueror's stacking adaptive force keeps your damage relevant into his rising HP pool while healing you back in the fight.

summoners.why: Overwhelmingly the standard pick at 87.2% and for good reason — Ignite's grievous wounds cuts directly into Mundo's passive regen and his R heal-over-time, turning your level 3-5 all-in into an actual kill instead of a reset.

playing.title: Hide behind minions before level 3
playing.detail: Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) does more to the first target it hits, so let a minion eat the initial cleaver rather than standing in open lane.

playing.title: All-in the instant E unlocks
playing.detail: At level 3, grab with E (Facebreaker), chain Q (Knuckle Down) for the double punch, and use W (Haymaker) to heal through the return damage. Waiting lets him hit level 6 and stabilize.

playing.title: Don't chase with slows
playing.detail: His passive clears slows the moment he casts an ability, so run him down with flat movement speed and stuns instead of expecting a slow to stick.

playing.title: Ignite before or right after his R
playing.detail: Maximum Dosage is a heal-over-time built on missing HP — landing Ignite before he pops it (or immediately after) removes most of the value he gets from it.

playing.title: Reset all-ins after your first back
playing.detail: Stridebreaker's active gives you a fresh gap-close; use the level 6-9 window to force another fight before he finishes his second item.

playing.title: Avoid free-hitting into his W stacks
playing.detail: Heart Zapper builds passive attack speed the longer he auto-attacks freely, so don't let him land uncontested hits during neutral wave states.

playing.title: Prioritize short trades over sieges late
playing.detail: Past level 16 he's very hard to outright kill in a long fight, so pick him off in isolated skirmishes rather than committing to a drawn-out 1v1.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the timing windows, ability interactions, and trade reasoning are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being chased by Dr. Mundo’s (Q) before reaching level 3. Afterwards, use your abilities off cooldown to engage combat to gain lane control.
